title: V-STATE — state compiler + publish workflow
desc:
DELIVERABLE: tools/build_state.py in dreamer2664/vigil — compiles app/state.json exactly per CONTRACT.md §2 (schema v1, all caps, deterministic ordering, normalize-friendly). Reads LOCAL checkouts only (no network): board/tasks + agents + bus from ./src/chatcode, PUSHES.md + shifts from ./src/storage, wire/*.jsonl from ./src/storagecode; --src-root and --out flags. Plus .github/workflows/state.yml: every 20 min + workflow_dispatch, checks out chatcode/superocr/storage/storagecode via repo-scoped token (secret STATE_TOKEN — read-only), runs the compiler, commits app/state.json to THIS repo (message 'state: refresh [skip ci]'), then it should ALSO drop a copy at storagecode app/state.json via the API if the token allows (optional, note result).
EVIDENCE: python3 tools/build_state.py --out /tmp/s.json → exits 0; json.load /tmp/s.json has every §2 key; counts match chatcode tasks list --status counts taken the same minute; run it twice → byte-identical files (determinism); paste the first 40 lines of one section in the PR.
OWNS: tools/build_state.py, .github/workflows/state.yml, tests/test_build_state.py
BRANCH: agent/<you>/<task-id>
